title: Bath & Body Works’ Halloween Fragrances Are Back, From ‘Vampire Blood’ to ‘Carnival Fog,’ Starting at $2
summary: Past Halloween favorites have sold out, but "Pumpkin Carving" and more viral scents are now on sale as Halloween takes over pop culture.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Spooky season has arrived early, and Bath & Body Works has the candles, fragrances and hand soaps to prove it. The retailer’s Halloween collection is back online, with some items starting at just $2 and several picks currently on sale.

The timing tracks with Halloween’s growing presence across pop culture. Tame Impala and JENNIE’s “Dracula” jumped from No. 25 to No. 8 on the July 11-dated Billboard Hot 100 , while stars like Heidi Klum, Vanessa Hudgens and Lady Gaga continue to make Halloween a yearly celebrity spectacle.

For fans ready to lean into the trend, Bath & Body Works has brought back some of its most recognizable spooky scents. Vampire Blood is available across products including hand soap and fragrance, while Pumpkin Carving gives candles and home fragrance a distinctly Halloween feel. Carnival Fog offers another option for shoppers looking beyond traditional fall scents.

VIRAL PICK

Vampire Blood Gentle & Clean Foaming Hand Soap

$2.95 $7.95 63% off

Buy Now at Bath & Body Works

An 8.75 fl oz hand soap with red berries, night-blooming jasmine and petrifying plum notes.

Add a seasonal scent to your hand-washing routine with this foaming soap. The Vampire Blood formula comes in a convenient pump bottle and features notes of red berries, night-blooming jasmine and plum.

SPOOKY & CUTE

Witchy Cat Scent Control Nightlight – Wallflowers Fragrance Plug

$9.97 $19.95 50% off

Compatible with any Wallflowers fragrance refill, sold separately.

This kitty-shaped Wallflowers plug does double duty as seasonal decor and a fragrance diffuser. Adjust the scent intensity to low, medium or high, and use the built-in night-light to add a little ambient light to your space.

DERMATOLOGIST APPROVED

Vampire Blood Body Wash

$7.97 $15.95 50% off

A 10 fl oz body wash that helps maintain skin’s natural moisture barrier.

Coffin-dry skin doesn’t stand a chance with this body wash. Its aloe- and panthenol-infused gel formula helps maintain the skin’s natural moisture barrier while cleansing and leaving behind a refreshing fragrance.

SPOOKY SCARY SKELETONS

Glow-in-the-Dark Dancing Skeleton 3-Wick Candle Holder

$8.47 $16.95 50% off

A large candle holder featuring a glow-in-the-dark skeleton design.

Light up your Halloween setup with this dancing skeleton 3-wick candle holder. Its glow-in-the-dark design adds a fun effect to your candle display, day or night.

EVERYTHING NICE

Pumpkin Carving 3-Wick Candle

$12.47 $24.95 50% off

This 3-wick candle is ideal for larger rooms and spaces, and made from a soy wax blend.

Made for chilly fall nights, this Pumpkin Carving candle fills larger spaces with a warm blend of pumpkin, spiced seeds and brown sugar. The three-wick design offers up to 45 hours of burn time and comes with a decorative lid.

FRIGHT NIGHT FIND

Carnival Fog Wallflowers Fragrance Refill

$4.47 $8.95 50% off

Fragrance crafted with a high concentration of rich oils.

For a Halloween scent that’s more mysterious than sweet, try Carnival Fog. The Wallflowers refill features notes of spooky autumn air, woody incense and midnight fog and delivers up to 30 days of noticeable fragrance.

GLOW WITH THE FLOW

Potion on Books Projector Nightlight – Wallflowers Fragrance Plug

$18.47 $36.95 50% off

Fill your room with your favorite elixir, and watch as potion swirls are projected behind the plug.

This Wallflowers plug is part fragrance diffuser, part night-light. The flameless design provides continuous scent, while the built-in light adds a soft glow to your room.

GHOULS JUST WANNA HAVE FUN

Ghoul Friend Single Wick Candle

A single wick candle known for its even, consistent burn from start to finish.

Ghoul Friend is back with its signature fruity-floral scent. The single-wick candle combines dark strawberries, ghostly peony and spine-chilling citrus and burns for up to 45 hours.

HEX THE GERMS

Light-up Cauldron PocketBac Holder

$6.47 $12.95 50% off

Designed to hold your on-the-go hand sanitizer from Bath & Body Works (sold separately).

Make your hand sanitizer part of your Halloween look with this cauldron PocketBac holder. The colorful light-up design clips onto your bag or keys and works with any PocketBac sanitizer.

The Halloween collection is especially worth a look for anyone who prefers their seasonal products with an extra spooky twist. Instead of limiting the lineup to pumpkin spice, the retailer leans into vampires, haunted carnivals and other Halloween-inspired themes.

Some previous Halloween favorites have already sold out, making the current sale an opportunity to grab the collection before more popular items disappear. Prices start at $2, so you can stock up on seasonal scents without turning your bathroom or home into a full-blown haunted house.

With Halloween showing up everywhere from the charts to celebrity culture, these scents are arriving right on time.
